raw_problem.problem_text: 一维无限深势阱中求处于 $\psi _ { n } ( x )$ 态的粒子的动量分布几率密度 $\left| \varphi ( p ) \right| ^ { 2 }$
raw_problem.solution_text:
因为 $\varphi _ { n } ( x ) = { \sqrt { \frac { 2 } { a } } } \sin { \frac { n \pi x } { a } }$ 是已知的，所以要求动量分布的几率密度，先要求动量波函数，这可利用福利衰变换的一维公式:

$$
\varphi_ {n} (p) = \frac {1}{\sqrt {2 \pi \hbar}} \int_ {0} ^ {a} \sqrt {\frac {2}{a}} e ^ {- i p x / \hbar} \sin \frac {n \pi x}{a} d x
$$

利用不定积分公式

$$
\int e ^ {a x} \sin p x d x = \frac {a \sin p x - p \cos p x}{a ^ {2} + p ^ {2}} e ^ {a x}
$$

用于前一式：

$$
\begin{array}{l} \varphi_ {n} (p) = \frac {1}{\sqrt {\pi \hbar a}} \cdot \frac {- \frac {i p}{\hbar} \sin \frac {n \pi x}{a} - \frac {n \pi}{a} \cos \frac {n \pi x}{a}}{\left(\frac {n \pi}{a}\right) ^ {2} - \left(\frac {p}{\hbar}\right) ^ {2}} e ^ {\left. i p x / \hbar \right| _ {0} ^ {a}} \\ = \frac {2 n \sqrt {a \pi \hbar^ {8}}}{a ^ {2} p ^ {2} - n ^ {2} \pi^ {2} \hbar^ {2}} \left\{\frac {- 1 + (- 1) ^ {n} e ^ {\frac {i p a}{\hbar}}}{2} \right\} \\ = \frac {- 2 n \sqrt {a \pi \hbar^ {3}}}{a ^ {2} p ^ {2} - n ^ {2} \pi^ {2} \hbar^ {2}} e ^ {\frac {i p a}{2 \hbar}} \cos \frac {p a}{2 \hbar} \quad (\mathrm {n} \text {奇 数}) \\ = \frac {- 2 n i \sqrt {a \pi \hbar^ {2}}}{a ^ {2} p ^ {2} - n ^ {2} \pi^ {2} \hbar^ {2}} e ^ {\frac {i p a}{2 \hbar}} \sin \frac {p a}{2 \hbar}, \quad (\mathrm {n} \text {偶 数}) \\ \end{array}
$$

动量几率密度分别是

$$
\begin{array}{l} \frac {4 n ^ {2} a \pi \hbar^ {2}}{\left(a ^ {2} p ^ {2} - n ^ {2} \pi^ {2} \hbar^ {2}\right) ^ {2}} \cos^ {2} \frac {p a}{2 \hbar}, \quad (\mathrm {n} \text {奇 数}) \\ \frac {4 n ^ {2} a \pi \hbar^ {2}}{(a ^ {2} p ^ {2} - n ^ {2} \pi^ {2} \hbar^ {2}) ^ {2}} \sin^ {2} \frac {p a}{2 \hbar}, \qquad (\mathrm {n} \text {偶 数}) \\ \end{array}
$$
